name: Mammon
source: Representing the demon Mammon and the corresponding sin of greed, she is the third youngest of the Stakes of Purgatory. She is extremely greedy and, with her ability to act quickly, will do anything to get what she wants, often leading her to start conflicts between her sisters. Unlike the other Stakes, however, she is the most honest emotionally. Mammon's appearance is a girl with long brown hair. In Alliance of the Golden Witch, she is Ange's best friend.
